This restaurant has gone downhill drastically from what it used to be, and unfortunately, I won’t be returning. A very disappointing experience overall.

I would give 4.5 /5 .

I visited this place and found it to be a pleasant experience overall. The outlet isn’t very large, but it has a neat and comfortable setup. At times, you may need to wait in a queue, but the service is prompt and efficient, which makes up for it. The ambience is cheerful, though the background music felt slightly repetitive.

During my visit, they were running an interesting offer — buy one and get another for just ₹13. I tried the Peri Peri Veg, Classic Veg, and Chicken Crunchies. The portions are meant for a single person, so while it may not be the most pocket-friendly option, the quality certainly makes it worth the spend.

The highlight for me was the burger. It stood out with its distinctive taste — juicy, spicy, and perfectly crunchy. The chicken was crisp, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. I particularly appreciated the attention to hygiene; they even cut the burger in half for you on request, all while wearing gloves, and provide gloves for customers too, so you can truly enjoy a mess-free indulgence.

Overall, I thoroughly enjoyed the food, ambience, and service. It’s a place that gives full value in terms of taste and experience.

Thank you and enjoy yourself!
